feature_completion.interpretation: All declared source-feature obligations are represented; completion remains sampled, with continuous standoff remnants. Exact human bulk paths remain a separate requirement.
feature_completion.resolution_limit: 0.5 mm material centres do not resolve subcell standoff remnants or prove surface/tolerance conformance.

plan_constraint.advance: Safe phase removal and required material are exhausted; positive stock-end cleanup and designated final feature passes are satisfied
plan_constraint.within_stage: All geometrically eligible productive cuts remain selectable; source-relative direction changes are orientation annotations, not reclamping events
plan_constraint.scope: Continuous mill-turn holding assumed; contact, fixture interference and rotary kinematics unmodelled; fixed sampled target and declared feature denominator

setups.label: Continuous mill-turn holding
assumptions: The part remains held in the user-assumed mill-turn machine.
Tool directions represent source-relative indexing; no release, reclamping or accepted orientation event is modeled.
External fixture geometry, contact mechanics, indexing trajectories and holder clearance are unmodeled.

stages.label: Side milling
stages.skipped_reason: No further sampled removal after long-reach top and bottom milling.

plan_presentations.orientation_note: Mill-turn — continuous holding. Directions are source-relative; no setup change is modelled. Reach is maximum modelled penetration, not a physical cutter catalogue. Bulk uses point shadows; feature passes retain admitted bounded envelopes.

three_step_bulk_diagnostic.note: Three long-reach bulk cuts leave drilling, deep features, stock-end cleanup and final profiling obligations.
